title: AI Audit Chain Payload — v3
description:
AI audit chain canonical payload (§2.3; shared by the write path, chain verification and evidence export). v3 adds `audit_review` to the `action` enum: a human review receipt about rows already on this chain is itself a row of the same chain, so «reviewed» cannot be back-filled without breaking a signature (AW-12). It is not an AI action — its `outcome` is always null, which the outcome vector already covers under `any-other-action`. Every other field is byte-for-byte v2. v2 stays published and its rows remain legal. → schemas/v2/audit-payload.schema.json.

审计哈希链 canonical payload（§2.3，写入、校验、导出共用）。v3：`action` 枚举新增 `audit_review` —— 对**已写入本链的审计行**的人类复核回执，本身就是**同一条链**上的一行，于是「已复核」不能被事后补写而不破签（AW-12）。它不是 AI 动作 —— `outcome` 恒为 null，结局向量已用 `any-other-action` 覆盖。其余字段与 v2 逐字相同。v2 保持已发布的样子、其行仍然合法。→ schemas/v2/audit-payload.schema.json。
